assertion.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 now checks that EbsOptimizedInfo exists before it selects instances by EBS maximum bandwidth (bug fix).

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The release note does not name the requirement, label or configuration that selects instances by EBS maximum bandwidth, and it does not say which instance types lack EbsOptimizedInfo.; consequence: The release note does not say what went wrong before the fix (for example a crash or a wrong selection), so the operational effect of the fix cannot be stated.
